note: RFC 9687 Section 4.3 Event 29 drops TCP. Both tagged action-list functions were re-read. SendHoldExpiryRunsTheEvent29ActionList advances the isolated SendHold deadline, now requires exact ErrSendHoldTimerExpired, and calls requireConnClosed after Run joins; that helper requires EOF or closed pipe and explicitly refuses deadline expiry. NoSendHoldExpiryLeavesTheSessionIntact advances one nanosecond less, retains Established and the armed timer, and fails if the transport drain reports a close. sendHoldTimerExpired invokes closeConn, backed by Run's common deferred close; a mere Run return is not the transport predicate. The new sentinel check strengthens rather than removes the existing close observation. No native test was run.
